steps.note: S1.1.1 states and quotes line 744: rows 0-1 subtract Ja+Rc, rows 2-3 change scratch to a+Vx, c+Gx, rows 4-5 add, rows 6-7 restore, net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c.
S1.1.2 gives bit-case central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2, side wires cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, other distinct triples already zero, self coefficient one.
S1.1.2 gives complex-case central coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2, side cancelling intersections zero and two, self coefficient one, so both net maps are y<-y+x.
S1.1.3 states the inverse schedule effects X<-X-Y, the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), and that each invocation restores its auxiliary wires.

The plan only says 'tabulate the orthogonal residual of every edge' (S1.3 method) and refers to 'the residual table' in S1.3.4; it never gives the per-edge residuals and dimensions, and its quote (line 1061) starts after the table.
The plan gives only that neighboring triple lines are orthogonal (S1.3.1); the side edge 2->5 argument (<t_X> inside t_Y^perp, complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2) appears nowhere.
S1.3.4 says only center 3->4 decreases (loses P⊗F⊗Q of dimension h) and the signed sum telescopes at gates; S1.3.2 gives sources N, sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N and absolute Wm-2N+2L.

Only a parenthetical in S1.3.5 asserts that every nonzero F_2 residual contains a norm-one vector hence has an orthonormal basis; nondegeneracy, the unit-vector construction and the absorption of alternating planes are not stated, and the S1.3.5 quote (line 1105) does not carry this.
S1.3.5 states and quotes L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2.

The plan never states that weight is additive mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors or the formula q_V-q_U = sum wt(v)[v.x] over an orthonormal basis; S1.3.7 only uses q_U in the definition of the frames and asserts the resulting translation-kernel product.

The plan never says wt(v) is odd, never gives the phase i^{eps[v.x]}, and never derives the kernel aI+bX_v from H diag(1,-1) H = X; S1.3.7 just asserts the kernel factorisation (S3.1's C=HSH identity is a different statement).
S1.3.7 quotes that the assertion holds on any number of columns by tensoring over columns, and S3.1.2/S3.1.4 state one child operation on the f axes per residual vector with exactly s_c such calls.

The plan never states the zero-label frame I and full-label frame C^{⊗m}, nor that X_a->Y_a carries C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a); it only mentions Z_{a,f} signs, the scalar i^{27f} and negating the bank (S3.1.4) and says 'after endpoint corrections every role receives C^{⊗m}' (S1.3.7), without the derivation.
S1.3.5 states both loss ratios are below 1/2 and S1.3.6 gives the deficit N-2L_b>0 with s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, so s<Wm (S1.3 claim states s_c<W_c m).
S1.3.8 states and quotes line 1331: both deficits exceed 20*2^-50, log m<20, m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-20*2^-50)>m(1-eta), hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^-50.

S1.4.1 gives the pivot at the topmost nonzero row's rightmost entry, clearing by lower-triangular elementary matrices on both sides, deleting pivot row and column and repeating, and Pi having exactly a ones (quote line 1384).

The S1.4 method has a single clause 'modulo a fixed odd prime power avoiding all denominators'; it does not mention the finite table of factors, the condition on diagonal numerators, or that the identities specialize to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors.

S1.4 method does the triangular changes of coordinates by controlled shifts in descending coordinate order and its motivation says each costs O(V) when the target follows its controls (lower triangular in tape order), with S1.4.0 giving the O(V) shift.
S1.4.2 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j for each one of Pi, yielding (h+d,d) with one interchange each and a in all.
The plan names only Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) with C_1=20 (S3.4); E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu, C_1=max{20,nu+3} and C_0=128mB^2 are not defined anywhere.

The plan gives no arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E or leaf bound 8e, nor the per-invocation count below E; S3.4 only asserts that depth is below Delta (S3.3.2's recurrence is the time recurrence F(e), a different thing).
The plan does not unroll any depth recurrence (no B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu, no A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}); S3.4 just asserts the depth is below Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}).

S3.4 states depth-ell values lie in 2^{-(p+ell)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^ell, that epsilon*C_1<1 gives Delta=o(p), so the guarded width is O(p) and every coefficient is exact (the exact p+Delta and Delta+3 bit counts are not named).
S3.5 states every row of H has absolute row sum one so disk arrays map to disk arrays and truncation errs by less than sqrt2*2^-p (quote line 2751).

summary: 16 of 26 sub-steps present, none wrong. Present: B1-B4, L3, L5, P3, R1-R4, M1, M3, M4, S4, S5. Absent: L1, L2, L4, P1, P2, P4, M2, S1, S2, S3. The plan carries the bank-exchange and rank-saving arithmetic well, but omits the residual table, the weight-mod-4 phase derivation, and the guard-width constants and depth recurrence (it only asserts a Delta bound).
